ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Binaries Write Suspicious Extensions
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows executables that write files with suspicious extensions

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\csrss\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RuntimeBroker\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sihost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\smss\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.iso$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.txt$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.iso$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$")))) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dllhost\.exe" AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\\\_\\_PSScriptPolicyTest\\_.*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe" AND (file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\GroupPolicy\\\\DataStore\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sysvol\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Policies\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Machine\\\\Scripts\\\\Startup\\\\.*")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$"))) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe" AND (file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WindowsApps\\\\Clipchamp.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\.ps1.*"))))
